guarantees.claim: The run_ack_i input of u_sha3 is tied to 1'b1 permanently, asserting acknowledgment and bypassing the power-spike REQ/ACK handshake.
The run_req_o output port of u_sha3 is left unconnected, discarding any power-spike request from the SHA3 core.
All error outputs (sha3_err, sha3_state_error, sha3_count_error, sha3_storage_rst_error) are connected to kmac-level nets, making error conditions observable outside the sha3 instance.
The EnMasking compile-time parameter is passed to the sha3 instance, controlling whether the core is built with masking logic.

assumptions.claim: When EnMasking is enabled, msg_data_masked must carry properly masked data (using fresh entropy) before msg_valid is asserted.
assumptions.risk: Unmasked secret plaintext enters the SHA3 core, leading to side-channel or data exposure.

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en[2] must accurately reflect a security escalation state that requires SHA3 to wipe or halt.
assumptions.cond: system in a compromised lifecycle state
assumptions.risk: The SHA3 core continues normal operation in a security-critical condition, potentially leaking secrets.

assumptions.claim: Control inputs (sha3_start, sha3_run, sha3_done) are sequenced correctly by the kmac controller so that no illegal combination reaches the SHA3 core.
assumptions.risk: SHA3 internal FSM may enter undefined behavior or corrupt internal state.

assumptions.claim: app_sha3_mode and app_keccak_strength are set to legal, supported values before sha3_start is asserted.
assumptions.risk: SHA3 may misinterpret the mode/strength, leading to wrong digest or state machine errors.

uncertain_points.claim: The squeezing_o output is explicitly unused; this may be intentional, but its absence could hide a squeeze/absorb mismatch.
uncertain_points.cond: after sha3_done is asserted or during squeezing
uncertain_points.risk: If kmac ignores the squeeze state, it might miss protocol violations or read invalid state data.

uncertain_points.claim: The power-spike REQ/ACK handshake is bypassed (run_ack_i tied high, run_req_o disconnected). The risk of simultaneous high-current draw remains unmitigated at this boundary.
uncertain_points.cond: when SHA3 core processes a block while other power-hungry blocks are active
uncertain_points.risk: Excessive IR drop could cause functional failures elsewhere in the chip.

uncertain_points.claim: Error outputs (sha3_err, sparse_fsm_error, count_error, keccak_storage_rst_error) are connected but their handling (logging, masking, alert escalation) is not visible here.
uncertain_points.risk: A detected fault may be ignored or not escalate to a system-wide security alert, compromising fault containment.

uncertain_points.claim: The msg_data_masked signal is used without local verification that sha3_rand_valid is asserted concurrently with msg_valid when masking is enabled.
uncertain_points.cond: EnMasking=1 and a message is being sent
uncertain_points.risk: SHA3 may process unmasked or stale random data, exposing secrets through the digest or intermediate state.
